answer.instructions: How positive is this product review?
criteria: Very negative: the reviewer is angry or unhappy
Neutral or mixed: good and bad in equal measure
Positive: the reviewer is happy with small reservations
Very positive: the reviewer loves it

items.state: Arrived broken, support ignored me for two weeks, and the refund never came. Avoid at all costs.
Absolutely love it! Best purchase of the year, works perfectly and looks gorgeous. Five stars.
It is okay. Nice screen, but the speakers are weak. Fine for the price, nothing special.
Disappointing. It works, but the battery barely lasts an hour and the strap feels cheap.
Good value. Sturdy, easy to set up, and the battery lasts a full day. Only the case feels a bit plain.
Worst purchase I have made this year. It stopped working after one day and smells like burnt plastic.
Outstanding quality. It exceeded every expectation and my whole family fights over it.
Average. Does what it says, no more. I would not buy it again, but I would not return it either.
Not good. Too small for the price and it took a month to arrive.
Happy with it. Works well and arrived on time. I would buy it again.
Total waste of money. Nothing like the photos, and the seller was rude when I complained.
Flawless. Fast delivery, perfect fit, and customer service even called to check I was happy.
Mixed feelings: great design, slow software. Some days I like it, some days I do not.
Below what I expected. The sound is tinny and the app keeps crashing.
Really nice blender, powerful and quiet enough. Cleaning is a little fiddly, but I like it.
Dangerous. The charger overheated and melted the plug. I want my money back.
Brilliant! I have recommended it to everyone I know. Cannot imagine going back to my old one.
Meh, I regret buying it. It does the job badly and looks worse than in the listing.
Decent but unremarkable. Setup was easy and the quality is just acceptable.
Solid headphones for the price. Comfortable and clear sound, though the bass could be stronger.
